rewrites.comment: Client-side routing: /login and every other route are served by the SPA shell, so a direct hit or a refresh does not 404.

headers.comment: Same policy as the platform portal, widened only for the two Google Fonts origins the app loads Inter and JetBrains Mono from. Self-host those two families and this collapses back to 'self' everywhere. connect-src is 'self' because the designer pack answers every API call from local fixtures; pointing VITE_API_URL at a real backend means adding that origin here.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'

headers.comment: Vite content-hashes everything under /assets, so those files are safe to cache forever. The shell that references them is not, and must always be revalidated.
